mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_metric_profile_version(tenant_id,profile_id,version,source,body_json,body_hash,created_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{id},#{version},#{source},#{bodyJson},#{bodyHash},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_id=profile_id
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,profile_id,version,source,body_json,body_hash,verification_state,published,created_at FROM orbit_metric_profile_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND profile_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orbit_metric_profile_version SET published=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND profile_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND published=0
